headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of August 19, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 24.75% compared to SPY's 13.64%. This 11.12% average alpha indicates that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered a notable return of 47.28%, significantly contributing to the overall outperformance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', returned 13.51%, still above the benchmark but less impactful. This relative performance is particularly relevant during periods of market stress or uncertainty, highlighting the portfolio's resilience. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
